facts.value: An emergency is an urgent, unexpected, and usually dangerous situation that poses an immediate risk to health, life, property, or environment and requires immediate action.

An incident, to be an emergency, conforms to one or more conditions if it poses an immediate threat to life, health, property, or environment; has already caused loss of life, health detriments, property damage, or environmental damage; or has a high probability of escalating to cause immediate danger.
